divinitySource: public/divinity-manual/index.html, Code 58 Branch on Difficulty Level
runtimeContract: Compare the signed saved difficulty directly with Extra Code 0, then branch to an XAP or transfer within the active Simple or Complex Encounter result at the authored zero-based code cursor.
controlFlow: Behavior 1 branches, behavior 2 exits and keeps the placed Action Point, behavior -2 exits and erases it, and a signed opcode carries GOSUB to the selected target.
determinism: The operation consumes no RNG and reads only the compiled Extra Code row, closed encounter context, and serialized difficulty.
